items.content_html:
Quite a lot of appearance sources come from randomized Garrison content. Regarding gear tokens (items with a Use effect that grant you a piece of equipment) in Garrison content, accessing them can be confusing and stat squishes have made it downright mysterious.

There are five sets of gear tokens from Garrison content, as follows:

Tormented Gear Tokens

Tormented gear tokens are the easiest to get. The missions that award them have a single requirement for their spawn:

  • Have one level 34 follower.
  • Have followers of varying levels, because some missions are weird.

This section still requires research. It has been noted that https://www.wowhead.com/mission=198/guinea-pigs, which awards the token for boots, may only spawn if you have followers around the level 33 range (32-37 at the very least). The logic is that a level 93 mission (as listed on WoWhead) has been squished to level 33, and will not spawn for a character with fully maxed followers.

Munificent Gear Tokens

This is where things get complicated. For the missions that award these to spawn, the following condition must be met:

  • The player character's item level must be 44 or lower.

In practice, this can be done on any character by deleting its gear until below the threshold. Note that gear in inventory also counts toward item level, so unequipping items won't work.

Turbulent Gear Tokens

To spawn the missions that award these, another condition appears:

  • The player character's item level must be 44 or lower.
  • Have at least three followers of item level 630+.

This can be accomplished quickly by using https://www.wowhead.com/item=128314/frozen-arms-of-a-hero on a level 40 follower.

In addition, four of the following tokens can be awarded at random from the https://www.wowhead.com/item=118924/cache-of-arms#contains, a reward from the daily Garrison Inn quest https://www.wowhead.com/quest=37167/and-no-maces :

  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114073/turbulent-hood
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114072/turbulent-gauntlets
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114074/turbulent-leggings
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114079/turbulent-cloak
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114087/grandiose-trinket

Grandiose Gear Tokens

It's getting even more complicated. Grandiose tokens come from two sources: A weekly mission on rotation, and missions; but not all Grandiose tokens can generate from missions!

To trigger the missions, the following conditions must be met:

  • The player character's item level must be 44 or lower.
  • Have at least three followers of item level 645+.

However, the missions can only randomly generate the following tokens:

  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114112/grandiose-armament
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114085/grandiose-spaulders
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114083/grandiose-robes
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114082/grandiose-bracers
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114084/grandiose-treads
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=114086/grandiose-choker

The other tokens can only be found in https://www.wowhead.com/item=123975/greater-bounty-spoils. Read more about how to get these bags in the next section. This means you'll need this bag for the following tokens:

  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=119116/grandiose-hood
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=119114/grandiose-gauntlets
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=119118/grandiose-leggings
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=119124/grandiose-cloak
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=119120/grandiose-girdle
  • https://www.wowhead.com/item=119122/grandiose-ring

Formidable Tokens & Greater Bounty Spoils

Formidable tokens cannot be acquired through Garrison missions. They can only be obtained from https://www.wowhead.com/item=123975/greater-bounty-spoils. This means that, upon opening this bag, you have a chance at receiving either a Grandiose or a Formidable token. If you're targeting a specific token, this means you have a 1/26 chance of actually getting it.

Here's a breakdown of how to get https://www.wowhead.com/item=123975/greater-bounty-spoils:

  • Every day, you have a visitor in your Tier 3 Garrison. Sometimes a vendor, sometimes a questgiver.
    • You're looking to find https://www.wowhead.com/npc=89753/high-overlord-saurfang (Horde)
    • Or https://www.wowhead.com/npc=89763/muradin-bronzebeard (Alliance)
    • If he's not up in your Garrison, you can totally visit a friend's Garrison if they have him.
  • When spawned, you will be offered a quest to kill the final boss of a WOD raid wing.
    • Once you complete one of these quests, you're locked from accepting any more until the weekly reset.
    • There are 12 quests in total, on a fixed rotation.
    • Five of them, sending you to Hellfire Citadel, award Apexis Crystals instead of Greater Bounty Spoils.
  • Pick up the quest, go into the specified LFR wing via https://www.wowhead.com/npc=94870/seer-kazal and complete the quest.
  • Once completed, that character cannot acquire Greater Bounty Spoils until the weekly reset.

Notes

  • Garrison missions spawn randomly. Some day you may find a mission for a token, other days not.
  • Sometimes you may see a Grandiose mission with only two 645+ followers. It's unclear what triggers it.

Optimized Collecting

The following content can be acquired on the side as part of this activity:

  • Link to page about the Salvage Yard transmogs.
